title: FGL09 9-round AES-256 / aes256-9r-related-key-boomerang-fgl2009

target.description: 9 nonlinear AES rounds with the initial whitening addition and no final MixColumns. The recovered material is specified below.The explicit filter recovers K0 bytes 0,5,10,15 and 3,4,9,14 plus K9 byte 4 (72 subkey bits).

setting.key_relation: XOR-related key quartets Ka,Kb=Ka XOR delta*,Kc=Ka XOR delta-prime,Kd=Ka XOR delta* XOR delta-prime; Section 4 chooses candidate b differences and repeats over key trials.
setting.plaintext_model: Section 4.4 requires 2^42.5 plaintext structures of 2^64 elements with adaptive inverse queries; Section 4.5 headline total 2^67 is disputed below.
assumptions: The prescribed nonlinear key-differential path occurs with probability 2^-14; this is a key-path condition, not attack success.
The source uniform/Poisson filtering model is used; no independent attack implementation was executed.

key_budget.note: Table 1 headline key budget; the fractional exponent is not rounded to a fabricated integer. Section 4.5 separately discusses 2^7.5 key trials and 127 b candidates.

time.note: Source filtering-work headline. Nine-round Section4.4 Step4 separately searches184 remaining cipher-key bits by trial encryption;2^142.83 is not a priced complete-master-key total.

data.note: The headline omits the visibly required2^42.5 structure multiplicity. Four oracles per2^64-text structure give2^66; multiplying by2^42.5 gives2^108.5 only under a literal non-reuse, fixed-quartet interpretation. Key-trial/reuse aggregation remains unresolved; no corrected total is assigned.

success.description: Source Section 4.5 reports about 0.8 from Pr(Poisson(3)>=2), but Step 3.6.2 accepts more than 2 quartets. Keep the reported value with its unresolved threshold conflict; ten-round analysis inherits the inner attack without a fresh success derivation. Conditional arithmetic: source Poisson(3)>=2 gives0.8008517265; literal algorithm >2 gives0.5768099189. Neither is inserted as independently verified AES success.

field_conflicts.description: The probability derivation and algorithm use different quartet thresholds; neither is silently substituted for the other.
